'''Tesien Jorhald''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].

== History ==
Her name indicates that she was likely from [[Tarabon]] as no other names ending in "hald" are from anywhere else (see [[Geofram Bornhald]], [[Aludra Nendenhald]], [[Androl Genhald]], [[Tazenia Nerenhald]]).

== Activities ==
In traditional Red Ajah custom, she forced [[Pevara Tazanovni]] to give up being friends with [[Seaine Herimon]] once Pevara was raised to the shawl.{{Ref/book|7|32}} This may indicate she was [[Highest]] of the Red Ajah at the time, but not necessarily so.
